void main() {
  int n = 42;
  float f = 3.14;
  char c = 'x';
  string s = "hello";
  bool b = true;
  bool b2 = false;
  read(n);
  print(s);
  print(n);
}
void main() {
  int x = 0;
  int y = 1;
  if (x == 0) { y = 1; } else { y = 0; }
  while (x < 10) { x = x + 1; }
  for (int i = 0; i < 5; i = i + 1) { print("loop"); }
  repeat { x = x - 1; } until (x <= 0);
  if (x != y && x >= 0 || !false) { return; }
  if (x > 0 ? true : false) { break; }
  continue;
}

void main() {
  int x = 0;
  int y = 1;
  if (x == 0) { y = 1; } else { y = 0; }
  while (x < 10) { x = x + 1; }
  for (int i = 0; i < 5; i = i + 1) { print("loop"); }
  repeat { x = x - 1; } until (x <= 0);
  if (x != y && x >= 0 || !false) { return; }
  if (x > 0 ? true : false) { break; }
  continue;
}

void main() {
  int x = 0;
  int y = 1;
  if (x == 0) { y = 1; } else { y = 0; }
  while (x < 10) { x = x + 1; }
  for (int i = 0; i < 5; i = i + 1) { print("loop"); }
  repeat { x = x - 1; } until (x <= 0);
  if (x != y && x >= 0 || !false) { return; }
  if (x > 0 ? true : false) { break; }
  continue;
}

  int n = 42;
  float f = 3.14;

  read(n);
  print(s);
  print(n);
}
void main() {
  int x = 0;
  int y = 1;
  if (x == 0) { y = 1; } else { y = 0; }
  while (x < 10) { x = x + 1; }
  for (int i = 0; i < 5; i = i + 1) { print("loop"); }
  repeat { x = x - 1; } until (x <= 0);
  if (x != y && x >= 0 || !false) { return; }
  if (x > 0 ? true : false) { break; }
  continue;
}

void main() {
  int x = 0;
  int y = 1;
  if (x == 0) { y = 1; } else { y = 0; }
  while (x < 10) { x = x + 1; }
  for (int i = 0; i < 5; i = i + 1) { print("loop"); }
  repeat { x = x - 1; } until (x <= 0);
  if (x != y && x >= 0 || !false) { return; }
  if (x > 0 ? true : false) { break; }
  continue;
}

void main() {
  int x = 0;
  int y = 1;
  if (x == 0) { y = 1; } else { y = 0; }
  while (x < 10) { x = x + 1; }
  for (int i = 0; i < 5; i = i + 1) { print("loop"); }
  repeat { x = x - 1; } until (x <= 0);
  if (x != y && x >= 0 || !false) { return; }
  if (x > 0 ? true : false) { break; }
  continue;
}

void main() {
  int x = 0;
  int y = 1;
  if (x == 0) { y = 1; } else { y = 0; }
  while (x < 10) { x = x + 1; }
  for (int i = 0; i < 5; i = i + 1) { print("loop"); }
  repeat { x = x - 1; } until (x <= 0);
  if (x != y && x >= 0 || !false) { return; }
  if (x > 0 ? true : false) { break; }
  continue;
}

  int n = 42;
  float f = 3.14;

  read(n);
  print(s);
  print(n);
}
void main() {
  int x = 0;
  int y = 1;
  if (x == 0) { y = 1; } else { y = 0; }
  while (x < 10) { x = x + 1; }
  for (int i = 0; i < 5; i = i + 1) { print("loop"); }
  repeat { x = x - 1; } until (x <= 0);
  if (x != y && x >= 0 || !false) { return; }
  if (x > 0 ? true : false) { break; }
  continue;
}

void main() {
  int x = 0;
  int y = 1;
  if (x == 0) { y = 1; } else { y = 0; }
  while (x < 10) { x = x + 1; }
  for (int i = 0; i < 5; i = i + 1) { print("loop"); }
  repeat { x = x - 1; } until (x <= 0);
  if (x != y && x >= 0 || !false) { return; }
  if (x > 0 ? true : false) { break; }
  continue;
}

void main() {
  int x = 0;
  int y = 1;
  if (x == 0) { y = 1; } else { y = 0; }
  while (x < 10) { x = x + 1; }
  for (int i = 0; i < 5; i = i + 1) { print("loop"); }
  repeat { x = x - 1; } until (x <= 0);
  if (x != y && x >= 0 || !false) { return; }
  if (x > 0 ? true : false) { break; }
  continue;
}

void main() {
  int x = 0;
  int y = 1;
  if (x == 0) { y = 1; } else { y = 0; }
  while (x < 10) { x = x + 1; }
  for (int i = 0; i < 5; i = i + 1) { print("loop"); }
  repeat { x = x - 1; } until (x <= 0);
  if (x != y && x >= 0 || !false) { return; }
  if (x > 0 ? true : false) { break; }
  continue;
}

  int n = 42;
  float f = 3.14;

  read(n);
  print(s);
  print(n);
}
void main() {
  int x = 0;
  int y = 1;
  if (x == 0) { y = 1; } else { y = 0; }
  while (x < 10) { x = x + 1; }
  for (int i = 0; i < 5; i = i + 1) { print("loop"); }
  repeat { x = x - 1; } until (x <= 0);
  if (x != y && x >= 0 || !false) { return; }
  if (x > 0 ? true : false) { break; }
  continue;
}

void main() {
  int x = 0;
  int y = 1;
  if (x == 0) { y = 1; } else { y = 0; }
  while (x < 10) { x = x + 1; }
  for (int i = 0; i < 5; i = i + 1) { print("loop"); }
  repeat { x = x - 1; } until (x <= 0);
  if (x != y && x >= 0 || !false) { return; }
  if (x > 0 ? true : false) { break; }
  continue;
}

void main() {
  int x = 0;
  int y = 1;
  if (x == 0) { y = 1; } else { y = 0; }
  while (x < 10) { x = x + 1; }
  for (int i = 0; i < 5; i = i + 1) { print("loop"); }
  repeat { x = x - 1; } until (x <= 0);
  if (x != y && x >= 0 || !false) { return; }
  if (x > 0 ? true : false) { break; }
  continue;
}
